grok.pulse: NQ holding a modest bid (~+0.5%) in thin Thanksgiving Globex trade (equity futures halt 1:00 PM ET) as the AI trade steadies after Wed's -4.7% intraday NDX flush/reversal, offset by Nvidia halting AI server shipments to SE Asia on new US export curbs and fresh Iran/Hormuz mine headlines.

@HIT (~7:06 AM ET): Global stocks and Nasdaq futures climb as AI trade rebounds, shrugging off latest US tariff salvo; Stoxx 600 +1.5% on tech — Bullish NQ
X News (~7:27 AM ET): Iran IRGC says oil tankers incl. a 2M-bbl supertanker hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz; Israel IDF (~6:50 AM ET) signals readiness for solo Iran strikes — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~4:15 AM ET): Brent futures -1% to $93.65; US envoy confirms direct talks with Iran on sanctions/Hormuz (~1:10 AM ET) — Mixed NQ
